headline: dbMetrics gains three selected-series compaction metric fields
summary: Adds counter, failure counter and duration histogram fields to the unexported dbMetrics struct for selected-series compaction. The struct is never serialized, and the fields are initialized and registered in newDBMetrics, so the only runtime effect is three new Prometheus metrics. A short summary is enough.
reason: Unexported metrics holder struct with no serialization; the new fields only back new metrics that are set up in newDBMetrics.
